comment: Starter set only. Issue #8 calls for 24 frozen tasks, four per category across six categories. Grow this file to that set, then freeze it before collecting scored results. Do not edit tasks mid-run.

tasks.prompt: Which file owns the GenieX process lifecycle in this repository? Answer with the file path.
What loopback port does the Kare service listen on by default? Answer with the port number.
Explain in two sentences why the intake cloud escalation is off by default.
A C# P/Invoke declares [DllImport("libc")] private static extern int Kill(int pid, int sig); and throws EntryPointNotFoundException at runtime. What is wrong? Answer in one sentence.
